opportunities.name: Book-to-film unit note (Gutenberg + IMDb → Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given book title, look it up on Project Gutenberg to get author and download count, look up its film adaptation on IMDb to get year and rating, then add a 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>' note.
steps: Open Project Gutenberg and click the 'Quick search' box
Type the book title and press Enter
Click the top (most-downloaded) matching result; record title, author and download count
Open IMDb (decline cookie prompt if shown), click 'Search IMDb'
Select all existing text, type the book title and press Enter
Click the chosen film adaptation in the Titles results; record year and IMDb rating
Open the Notes app and click the 'New note' textbox
Type 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>' and press Enter

instances.values: book=Frankenstein; Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; film 2025, rated 7.4
book=Pride and Prejudice; Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; film 2005, rated 7.8
book=Treasure Island; Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; film 1990, rated 7.0 (interleaved with Wikipedia Morocco lookup)

opportunities.name: Country geography note (Wikipedia + timeanddate → Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given country, look it up on Wikipedia for capital, population, languages and currency, get the current local time in its capital on timeanddate.com, then add a 'Geography: ...' note.
steps: Open Wikipedia and click 'Search Wikipedia'
Type the country name and press Enter to open its article
Record capital, population, official languages and currency from the infobox
Open timeanddate.com (deny cookies if prompted) and click 'Search for city or place…'
Type the capital city name and press Enter
Click the result matching '<Country>, <Capital>'; record the current local time and timezone abbreviation
Open the Notes app and click the 'New note' textbox
Type 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <population>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time> <tz>' and press Enter

instances.values: country=Peru, capital=Lima; pop 34,157,732, PEN, 12:55:16 PET (allrecipes detour in between)
country=Vietnam, capital=Hanoi; pop 102,300,000, VND, 01:00:03 ICT (several typo'd searches first)
country=Morocco, capital=Rabat; pop 36,828,330, MAD, 18:05:56 GMT (interleaved with IMDb Treasure Island)

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for '<museum> tickets', skip date selection, and open the top ticket/tour listing to review it.
steps: Open Viator (reject cookies if prompted)
Click the 'Search for a place or activity' box and select all existing text
Type '<museum name> tickets' and press Enter
If a date picker appears, click 'Skip'
On the results page, click the first relevant listing to open its details

instances.values: query='Natural History Museum tickets'; opened Field Museum of Natural History Admission Tickets ($29)
query='Louvre tickets' (after a garbled first attempt); opened Paris Louvre 6-people Tour with Pre-Reserved Tickets ($66)
query='Rijksmuseum tickets'; opened Rijksmuseum Amsterdam Ticket and Canal Cruise with Audio Guide ($44)
